R_CORE: Universal Core: SOLID principles, high cohesion, low coupling, standard English naming and documentation, clear layer boundaries, no over-engineering.
R_NODE: Node.js: Express REST APIs, Handler-Dispatcher architecture (canHandle/handle), Interceptor pipelines, Error boundaries, Mongoose/MongoDB/SQL, Service-layer business logic.
R_REACT: React: Functional Components, Hooks (useState/useEffect/useMemo/useCallback), Redux Toolkit/Zustand, strict English RESTful routing, centralized apiClient, zero inline window.location redirects.
R_CS: C# .NET: Modern C# syntax, Task/async naming suffixes (e.g. GetListAsync), pattern matching, native ArgumentNullException, <=40 lines/method, strong typing.
R_WPF: WinForms/WPF ERP: STRICTLY NO BindingSource. BaseForm/XtraForm pattern, RunAfterShown delegate initialization, PopulateControls/CollectData 1-way manual mapping, safe async void exception catching.
R_API: Web API: Clean Architecture / Folder-per-feature, Autofac/Microsoft DI, Controller -> Service -> Repository layer separation, strict DTO localization.
R_GO: Go: Goroutines, Channels, GoFlow toolkit, errgroup, typed worker pools (PoolWithFunc), explicit error handling, interface segregation.
R_PHP: PHP 8+: strict_types=1, PSR-4 autoloading, PDO parameterized queries (LiteORM CLI), JWT/Crypto security, thin controllers.
R_DB: Database: Parameterized queries ONLY. Verify column mappings. Mandatory audit logging for writes. Schema modifications require isolated migration/rollback scripts.
R_PUB: .NET Publish: Support both Full (Self-contained, SingleFile) and Lite (Framework-dependent, SingleFile) configurations.
R_UNIVERSE: Universe Plugin v4.0: Data sovereignty, indirect event communication (EventBus/MessageQueue), auto-registry, strict module isolation. Deleting a module folder must not break project build.
R_EVT: Event-Driven: Decoupled domain events, Transactional Outbox pattern for dual-write safety, Idempotent consumers, asynchronous messaging.
R_RES: Resilience: Circuit Breaker, Exponential Backoff with Jitter, explicit timeouts, Fallback cache (Stale-While-Revalidate), graceful degradation.
R_TDD: Test-Driven Development: Red-Green-Refactor cycle, reproduction test first, minimum production code, regression verification.
R_PERF: High-Performance Compute: Span<T>, Memory<T>, ArrayPool<T>, NativeMemory, SIMD Vector128/256/512, cache alignment, zero GC allocations in tight loops.
R_CPP: Modern C++ & Native Interop: C++20 standard, C-ABI export boundaries, [LibraryImport] Source Generators, Pinned memory, zero-copy pointer exchanges.
R_PIPE: Tiled Data Pipeline: Producer-Consumer Channels, Bounded queues, Ring Buffers, Tile Partitioning for data exceeding physical RAM.
